responsibility: Builds and rebuilds callgraph edges and IPA reference lists from GIMPLE bodies and static initializers. It walks statements, PHIs, EH metadata, OpenMP child-function references, address-taken expressions, and variable initializers to create direct and indirect cgraph edges plus ipa_ref links for functions and variables. The file also provides the dedicated build/rebuild/remove passes that keep callgraph/reference information synchronized after transformations that do not update it incrementally.
